args.sql:
WITH ranked_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.accindex AS account_id,
        ma.authenscore AS engagement_authenticity_score,
        sb.acttimedist->>'timing_pattern' AS timing_pattern,
        'Manipulator' AS status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ma.authenscore DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        account a
    JOIN 
        profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
    JOIN 
        sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
    JOIN 
        moderationaction ma ON a.accindex = ma.macntref
)
SELECT 
    account_id, 
    engagement_authenticity_score,
    timing_pattern,
    status
FROM 
    ranked_accounts
LIMIT 10;

args.sql:
WITH ranked_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.accindex AS account_id,
        ma.authenscore AS engagement_authenticity_score,
        sb.acttimedist->>'timing_pattern' AS timing_pattern,
        'Manipulator' AS status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ma.authenscore DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        account a
    JOIN 
        profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
    JOIN 
        sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
    JOIN 
        moderationaction ma ON a.accindex = ma.macntref
)
SELECT 
    account_id, 
    engagement_authenticity_score,
    timing_pattern,
    status
FROM 
    ranked_accounts
LIMIT 10;
